title: Is the Bible reliable? The canon and its critics
tagline: How we got the Bible, why Catholics have 73 books, and what to say about “contradictions”.
whyItMatters: Many doubts about the faith begin with doubts about the Bible. A calm, informed answer helps friends and strengthens your own reading.

mindset.tip: Ask what the person has actually read or heard, then answer that, not a stock objection. (1 Peter 3:15-16)
Listen to sceptical scholars in their own words; honest doubts deserve honest answers.
Admit what is hard. Saying “I do not know yet, let me look” builds trust.
Remember that the Church teaches that Scripture is inspired and true, and also that it must be read with care. (CCC 105-108, 109-114)
